clips.name: allanims

inferred_segments.role: large weapon motion plus second pump cycle

clips.note: The donor contains one concatenated clip, not separately named production actions. Segment names are inferred from mechanical-node motion and must be cut explicitly during retarget.

trigger.rotation: approximately 7.6 degrees around local X, returning to rest

project_weapon.implication: Pump, loading port and tube sockets do not exist as authored nodes. They must be added as non-rendering control bones/empties after visual registration against the intact project mesh; the mesh itself must not be replaced or split by donor geometry.

project_socket_targets: ShotgunPump at the visible project fore-end center
ShotgunPort at the visible loading window
ShotgunTube just inside the port along the magazine-tube axis
ShotgunShellPivot parented to the approved support wrist during carry
socket_registration.warning: Normalized donor values are only initial search coordinates. Final sockets require direct visual registration on the project mesh because the donor and project proportions differ.

retarget_plan: Import donor motion into an isolated temporary collection and delete/disable all donor meshes, materials, images and skins before export selection.
Cut allanims into explicit Fire 0.000-1.133 and Reload 1.167-2.933 working ranges; keep later inferred ranges out until independently identified.
Retarget donor arm transforms to the approved project rig using the exact/renamed mapping, preserving the approved project hand mesh and CoroSolto_FP_Gloves material.
Lock R_arm_024/R_elbow_025/R_wrist_026 to a single registered ShotgunGrip pose for every Reload frame; only recoil may affect the weapon/root during Fire.
Register ShotgunPump, ShotgunPort and ShotgunTube sockets on the intact project shotgun mesh. Do not copy donor base/lid/pump geometry.
Create a closed project-authored shell mesh with its origin at ShotgunShellPivot. Parent its rigid control to L_wrist_02 from pickup through carry.
At insert, constrain the shell pivot continuously between the support-hand grip offset and ShotgunPort, ending just inside ShotgunTube. Hide it only after the center crosses the port plane.

Drive pump motion through a non-rendering control and the support hand; if the monolithic project mesh cannot expose a safe pump sub-part without destructive geometry edits, animate the hand gesture only and record the mechanical limitation.
Export only the project weapon, approved project hands, project-authored shell and actions. Reject the export if any donor mesh/material/texture/skin name survives.
Validate with deterministic carry, approach, contact and post-insert frames. Any positive shell-to-hand gap before contact or shell-to-port gap at insertion fails the gate.
limitations: The donor exposes one concatenated clip; segment labels after 2.933 seconds remain inferred.
The project shotgun is monolithic and contains no authored pump or loading-port nodes.
Socket coordinates cannot be transferred 1:1 because donor and project weapon proportions differ.
